paragraphs.title: Ahaziah Becomes King and the Influence of Ahab’s House

easy.explanation: Ahaziah, Jehoram’s youngest son, was made king in his father’s stead.
easy.q: Who became king of Judah after Jehoram’s older sons were slain?

easy.explanation: The KJV says, “His mother’s name also was Athaliah.”
Ahaziah reigned one year in Jerusalem.
easy.q: How long did Ahaziah reign in Jerusalem?

answers: Because the older sons had been slain
medium.explanation: The older sons had been slain, so Ahaziah became king.
medium.q: Why was Ahaziah, the youngest son, made king?

medium.explanation: A counsellor is someone who gives advice or guidance.

answers: They encouraged him to do wickedly
They taught him to seek the LORD
They urged him to leave the throne
medium.explanation: His mother was his counsellor to do wickedly, and others led him in the ways of Ahab’s house.
medium.q: How did Athaliah and Ahaziah’s counsellors influence him?

answers: That Ahaziah lived in Ahab’s house
That he followed Ahab’s evil ways
That he fought against Ahab’s family
challenge.explanation: The phrase means that Ahaziah followed the wicked example of Ahab’s house.
challenge.q: What does “the ways of the house of Ahab” mean in this passage?

challenge.explanation: The KJV states that Ahaziah was forty and two years old.
challenge.q: How old was Ahaziah when he began to reign?

answers: His counsellors led him to destruction
He appointed Jehoiada as his counsellor
challenge.explanation: After his father’s death, his counsellors became a cause of his destruction.
challenge.q: What happened after Ahaziah’s father died?

paragraphs.title: The War at Ramoth-gilead and the Visit to Jehoram

easy.explanation: Ahaziah went with Jehoram the son of Ahab to war.
easy.q: With whom did Ahaziah go to war?

easy.explanation: They fought against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth-gilead.
easy.q: Against whom did Jehoram and Ahaziah fight?

easy.explanation: Jehoram returned to Jezreel to be healed.
easy.q: Where did Jehoram return after he was wounded?

answers: Jehoram was wounded, returned to Jezreel, and Ahaziah visited him
Ahaziah was captured, Jehoram went to war, and then they met
Jehu came to Jerusalem, and Ahaziah followed him to war
medium.explanation: Jehoram was wounded and returned to Jezreel; afterward Ahaziah went to see him.
medium.q: What was the order of events in these verses?

answers: To visit Jehoram, who was sick
medium.explanation: Ahaziah went down to see Jehoram because Jehoram was sick.
medium.q: Why did Ahaziah go to Jezreel?

answers: Chosen and appointed for a task
medium.explanation: Jehu had been appointed by the LORD for the task of cutting off Ahab’s house.
medium.q: What does “anointed” mean in this passage?

answers: Ahaziah came to Jezreel and went out with Jehoram when Jehu came against them
Ahaziah escaped from Jehu and came to him alone
Jehu invited Ahaziah to come from Jerusalem
challenge.explanation: When Ahaziah came to Jehoram, he went out with him and encountered Jehu.
challenge.q: How did Ahaziah’s visit to Jehoram bring him into contact with Jehu?

answers: To cut off the house of Ahab
challenge.explanation: The LORD had anointed Jehu to cut off the house of Ahab.
challenge.q: For what purpose had the LORD anointed Jehu?

answers: He became involved in Ahab’s house and its fate
He opposed the house of Ahab
He ended Judah’s relationship with Israel
challenge.explanation: By joining Jehoram, Ahaziah became involved with the house Jehu had been appointed to destroy.
challenge.q: What does Ahaziah’s joining Jehoram suggest?

paragraphs.title: Jehu Destroys the Allies of Ahab’s House

answers: The princes of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah’s brothers
easy.explanation: Jehu found and killed the princes of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah’s brothers.
easy.q: Whom did Jehu kill while executing judgment on Ahab’s house?

easy.explanation: Ahaziah was brought to Jehu, killed, and buried.
easy.q: What happened to Ahaziah after he was caught?

answers: They were serving Ahaziah while Jehu judged Ahab’s house
medium.explanation: They were found ministering to Ahaziah during Jehu’s judgment against Ahab’s house.
medium.q: Why were the princes of Judah and Ahaziah’s relatives killed?

answers: He was buried, hid, and then caught
He hid, was caught, killed, and buried
He was killed, hid, and then buried
medium.explanation: Ahaziah hid in Samaria, was caught, killed, and buried.
medium.q: What was the order of events concerning Ahaziah?

answers: No strong leader remained in his house to hold the kingdom
medium.explanation: After Ahaziah’s death, no powerful leader remained to maintain his dynasty’s rule.
medium.q: What does “had no power to keep still the kingdom” mean?

answers: Because he was the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought the LORD with all his heart
Because he defeated Hazael in battle
challenge.explanation: He was buried because he was the son of Jehoshaphat, who had sought the LORD wholeheartedly.
challenge.q: Why was Ahaziah buried, according to the passage?

answers: The princes of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah’s brothers
challenge.explanation: Jehu killed the princes of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah’s brothers.
challenge.q: Who else was killed besides Ahaziah?

answers: His house had no power to keep the kingdom
His house gained control of Syria
challenge.explanation: The passage says that Ahaziah’s house had no power to keep the kingdom.
challenge.q: What political result followed Ahaziah’s death?

paragraphs.title: Athaliah Seizes Power and Joash Is Hidden

answers: She destroyed all the seed royal
easy.explanation: Athaliah arose and destroyed all the seed royal of Judah.
easy.q: What did Athaliah do when she saw that her son was dead?

easy.explanation: Jehoshabeath took Joash and hid him.
Joash was hidden in the house of God for six years.
easy.q: How long was Joash hidden in the house of God?

answers: To prepare him for war against Syria
medium.explanation: Jehoshabeath hid Joash so that Athaliah would not kill him.

answers: In a bedchamber in the house of God
medium.explanation: They were placed in a bedchamber in the house of God.
medium.q: Where were Joash and his nurse hidden?

medium.explanation: The passage says that Jehoshabeath was the sister of Ahaziah.
medium.q: What family relationship did Jehoshabeath have to Ahaziah?

answers: Athaliah destroyed the royal seed, and Jehoshabeath rescued Joash
Jehoshabeath made Joash king, and Athaliah hid him
Athaliah fled, and Joash was taken to Samaria
challenge.explanation: Athaliah sought to destroy the royal family, but Jehoshabeath rescued and hid Joash.

answers: A woman who cared for and nursed the child
challenge.explanation: Joash’s nurse was the woman who cared for him while he was hidden.
challenge.q: What is a nurse in this passage?

answers: Athaliah ruled the land while Joash remained secretly hidden
Joash openly ruled for six years
Athaliah hid in the house of God
challenge.explanation: Joash remained hidden for six years while Athaliah reigned over the land.
challenge.q: What does Joash’s hiding for six years show?
